extracted.name: Tortilla Rollups
extracted.description: Cream cheese, sour cream, and taco seasoning are spread on soft tortillas in this easy recipe for roll-ups that both kids and adults alike will enjoy.
instruction_lines: Mix cream cheese, sour cream, green onions, and taco seasoning in a bowl until well blended.
Spread a thin layer of cream cheese mixture onto each tortilla. Roll each tortilla tightly to create a long tube. Spread more cream cheese mixture on the edges of each tortilla to seal.
Freeze rolls on a baking sheet for 20 minutes for easier slicing. Cut each roll into 1-inch pieces and thaw before serving.
